# Parent v1 replay fixtures

These raw Temporal JSON histories were generated by an ephemeral worker from
exact Git SHA `1e4a6c7dec90198dc472c270edf108c112ef3bdf`, not by the current
checkout's `LegacyDiagnosisTemporalWorkflow`. `manifest.json` records the
producer SHA, parent workflow-module hash, local image ID, workflow/run IDs,
event counts, and SHA-256 for every raw history.

The three artifacts cover a pre-ready rejected update, owner-wait plus
validation followed by `APPROVED`, and critic-terminal `NEEDS_HUMAN` without an
owner command. The current deterministic Replayer test verifies each manifest
entry before passing only the archived histories to the current frozen v1
class.

To regenerate intentionally, build a parent-only image from a detached parent
worktree, stop the current worker, then mount
`control_plane/tools/generate_parent_temporal_histories.py` into that image:

```bash
PARENT_SHA=1e4a6c7dec90198dc472c270edf108c112ef3bdf
PARENT_WORKTREE="$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/flowpulse-parent.XXXXXX)"
git worktree add --detach "$PARENT_WORKTREE" "$PARENT_SHA"
docker build --label "io.flowpulse.producer_git_sha=$PARENT_SHA" \
  -t flowpulse-parent-1e4a6c7-history:local "$PARENT_WORKTREE/control_plane"
docker compose stop worker
OUTPUT_DIR="$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/flowpulse-parent-history.XXXXXX)"
IMAGE_ID="$(docker image inspect flowpulse-parent-1e4a6c7-history:local --format '{{.Id}}')"
docker run --rm --network control_plane_default \
  -e FLOWPULSE_PARENT_SHA="$PARENT_SHA" \
  -e FLOWPULSE_PRODUCER_IMAGE_ID="$IMAGE_ID" \
  -e FLOWPULSE_PARENT_FIXTURE_SIGNING_KEY="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" \
  -e FLOWPULSE_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS=temporal:7233 \
  -e FLOWPULSE_HISTORY_OUTPUT_DIR=/out \
  -v "$PWD/tools/generate_parent_temporal_histories.py:/generator.py:ro" \
  -v "$OUTPUT_DIR:/out" flowpulse-parent-1e4a6c7-history:local python /generator.py
docker compose up -d --build worker
```

`--rm` stops the parent producer after its three histories are exported. Review
the new manifest and hashes before intentionally replacing these fixtures.
